integrity: All finite algebraic root counts, signs and return-derivative inequalities have been replayed using exact rational symbolic arithmetic in verification/check.py; no independent audit has been performed, and numerical coordinates are illustrative only.
scientific_limitations: Exact rational parameters (9/10,-6013/10000,2,1/2) only; counts all real primitive two-cycles but not larger periods, other parameter values, or attractor membership. Older numerical literature may have observed the same orbit, and the full 1994 Nusse–Yorke–Kostelich monograph and the revised 1997 Nusse–Yorke edition could not be exhaustively inspected.
title: One primitive two-cycle in the classical Tinkerbell map: an exact global census
